confirmed_findings: Training remained finite; the full reliability run was rejected by the planned development gate.
Interaction-model probability metrics overfit earlier than their score metrics.
Static-reference out-of-time alliance scores were systematically biased low in weeks 6, 8, and 10.
The low bias persisted across observation-count slices.
Total-minus-auto/teleop residuals were too small to explain the forecast bias.
plausible_contributors: A single static Z_base cannot represent week-to-week robot improvement or event-local state.
Held-out event populations and score scales shifted strongly beyond the preceding training distribution.
Score forecasts are derived from phase heads rather than directly supervising total score and score differential.
The heterogeneous homoscedastic objective is not aligned with a single headline forecast metric.
